about: Candidate floor for NIDO Esencial, measured from the locally built knowledge-packs-v10 candidate (tanda C-04, 2026-11-01). NOT published: the version lane folds these counts into knowledge-packs/release-ledger.json when v10 actually ships. A future Esencial candidate below these counts would silently take guides away from everyone who updates.

previousPublished.note: Size read from the signed catalog (src/models/manifest.ts) of the published v6 files; the trilingual candidate is +8192 bytes per file, not the ~+0.6 MB estimated in preparation.
